options.explanation: Incorrect: High TTL delays DNS propagation and weighted records lack automated readiness auditing.

options.text: Amazon Athena queries on CloudFront access logs
options.explanation: Incorrect: Athena log queries do not provide active routing control switches.

options.text: AWS CodeDeploy Blue/Green in single-region mode
options.explanation: Incorrect: Single-region CodeDeploy cannot manage multi-region DNS failover.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) helps build applications that recover from impairments faster by continually evaluating recovery readiness and providing simple, reliable routing controls.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: An organization manages its infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation. Over time, engineers made manual emergency changes directly in the AWS Console (e.g., modifying security group rules and changing instance sizes). How can the architect identify all differences between the expected template state and actual deployed infrastructure across stacks?

options.text: Attach an IAM Boundary to the VPC Internet Gateway.
options.explanation: Incorrect: IAM Boundaries cannot be attached to Internet Gateways.

options.text: Enable Amazon S3 Object Lock on the CloudFormation template bucket.
options.explanation: Incorrect: S3 Object Lock prevents template file deletion, but does not detect runtime infrastructure drift.

options.text: Delete all stacks and redeploy from scratch during business hours.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Deleting production stacks causes massive service outages and data loss.

options.text: Run CloudFormation Drift Detection on the deployed stacks.
options.explanation: Correct: CloudFormation Drift Detection compares the current live state of infrastructure against the deployed CloudFormation template and reports exact configuration differences (drift).

questions.generalExplanation: AWS CloudFormation Drift Detection identifies resources that have been modified outside of CloudFormation management, helping restore infrastructure consistency.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: An e-commerce company needs to collect client-side performance telemetry directly from actual end-user browsers (including page load timing, JavaScript runtime errors, browser types, and geolocation) to identify front-end performance bottlenecks. Which AWS feature provides this capability?

options.text: AWS CloudTrail Data Events
options.explanation: Incorrect: CloudTrail logs AWS API calls, not browser JavaScript errors or page load timing.

options.text: AWS Network Firewall
options.explanation: Incorrect: Network Firewall is a VPC firewall, not a browser client performance monitoring tool.

options.text: Amazon CloudWatch RUM (Real User Monitoring)
options.explanation: Correct: CloudWatch RUM collects and analyzes client-side application performance data directly from real end users' browsers, giving visibility into page load times, client-side errors, and user journeys.

options.text: Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics Canaries
options.explanation: Incorrect: Synthetics runs simulated synthetic scripts, not telemetry collected from real human end users.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon CloudWatch RUM enables real-user monitoring by embedding a lightweight JavaScript snippet in web applications to gather client-side performance and error data.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: A compliance audit requires querying 5 years of historical AWS CloudTrail management and data events across 200 AWS accounts using standard SQL without provisioning S3 buckets, Glue crawlers, or Athena tables. Which managed feature should be enabled?

options.text: AWS CloudTrail Lake with an event data store configured for 7-year retention.
options.explanation: Correct: CloudTrail Lake is a managed data lake for auditing and security analysis that stores events with customizable retention (up to 7 years) and supports direct SQL querying without managing S3, Glue, or Athena infrastructure.

options.text: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive without extraction keys.
options.explanation: Incorrect: S3 Glacier Deep Archive cannot be directly queried with real-time SQL without restoring objects.

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB with global secondary indexes.
options.explanation: Incorrect: DynamoDB is not cost-effective for querying multi-terabyte 5-year log datasets with ad-hoc SQL.

options.text: Amazon EC2 instance running Microsoft Access database.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Access is a desktop database incapable of handling multi-account enterprise audit logs.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS CloudTrail Lake provides a managed, immutable data store with built-in SQL query capabilities for analyzing activity and compliance across an AWS Organization.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: A microservices application needs to connect an Amazon DynamoDB Stream to an Amazon SQS queue with point-to-point filtering, data transformation, and enrichment, without writing and maintaining custom AWS Lambda integration code. Which feature accomplishes this?

options.text: Amazon EventBridge Pipes
options.explanation: Correct: EventBridge Pipes creates point-to-point integrations between event sources (DynamoDB Streams, Kinesis, SQS) and targets with built-in filtering, enrichment (API Destinations/Lambda), and transformation without boilerplate code.

options.text: Amazon CloudFront distribution with Origin Shield
options.explanation: Incorrect: CloudFront is a web CDN, not a serverless streaming event pipe.

options.text: Amazon Route 53 Resolver Outbound Endpoint
options.explanation: Incorrect: Route 53 Resolver manages DNS queries, not stream data transformation.

options.text: AWS Glue ETL batch job running every 24 hours
options.explanation: Incorrect: 24-hour batch jobs fail real-time stream processing requirements.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon EventBridge Pipes provides a simple, consistent, and cost-effective way to create point-to-point integrations between event producers and consumers without writing integration code.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: An operations team wants to use machine learning to automatically detect operational anomalies (such as memory leaks, under-provisioned DynamoDB tables, or database lock contentions), correlate related alarms, and receive actionable remediation suggestions before service degradation occurs. Which service provides this?

options.text: Amazon Polly
options.explanation: Incorrect: Polly converts text into lifelike speech.

options.text: AWS CodeCommit
options.explanation: Incorrect: CodeCommit is a Git repository service.

options.text: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Mode
options.explanation: Incorrect: Storage Gateway is a hybrid storage appliance.

options.text: Amazon DevOps Guru
options.explanation: Correct: Amazon DevOps Guru uses machine learning informed by years of Amazon.com operational experience to automatically detect operational issues, correlate metrics/logs into insights, and recommend fixes.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon DevOps Guru is an ML-powered operational service that continuously monitors applications to identify anomalies and recommend actionable remediation steps.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: A product team wants to safely launch new UI features in production by testing different variations with select percentages of user traffic (A/B testing) and using feature flags with instant kill switches if error rates increase. Which CloudWatch capability enables this?

options.text: Amazon QuickSight
options.explanation: Incorrect: QuickSight is a BI reporting dashboard tool.

options.text: AWS Snowcone
options.explanation: Incorrect: Snowcone is an edge data transfer appliance.

options.text: AWS CloudHSM
options.explanation: Incorrect: CloudHSM is a cryptographic key hardware security module.

options.text: Amazon CloudWatch Evidently
options.explanation: Correct: CloudWatch Evidently enables developers to implement feature flags and conduct A/B experiments on live application features, measuring impact on business metrics and technical performance.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon CloudWatch Evidently makes it easy for developers to safely launch new features with feature flags and validate features with statistical experimentation in production.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: A serverless application with thousands of concurrent AWS Lambda invocations connects directly to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database, causing database connection exhaustion and frequent timeouts. How can the architecture be improved to pool and share database connections efficiently?

options.text: Deploy Amazon RDS Proxy between AWS Lambda and the RDS database.
options.explanation: Correct: Amazon RDS Proxy pools and shares established database connections, reducing database memory/CPU connection overhead and reducing failover times by up to 66%.

options.text: Increase the Lambda concurrency limit to 100,000.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Increasing Lambda concurrency exacerbates connection exhaustion on the relational database.

options.text: Change the RDS database to Single-AZ.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Single-AZ reduces database availability and does not solve connection scaling.

options.text: Store database passwords in plaintext in public S3 buckets.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Plaintext password storage is a critical security vulnerability.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon RDS Proxy allows applications to pool and share database connections, protecting databases against connection saturation and improving serverless scalability.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: A central Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team in Account A needs to view CloudWatch metrics, search logs, and examine X-Ray traces originating from applications across 100 source accounts in an organization without logging into each account individually. Which feature should they configure?

options.text: CloudWatch Cross-Account Observability, designating Account A as the monitoring account and sharing telemetry from source accounts via AWS Organizations.
options.explanation: Correct: CloudWatch Cross-Account Observability allows central monitoring accounts to seamlessly search logs, aggregate metrics, and view traces across multiple linked accounts without custom pipeline infrastructure.

options.text: Deploy an Application Load Balancer in each source account.
options.explanation: Incorrect: ALBs route web traffic; they do not aggregate cross-account CloudWatch metrics and traces.

options.text: Use AWS Storage Gateway File mode across all accounts.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Storage Gateway is a hybrid storage bridge.

options.text: Export logs daily to CSV files and email them to the SRE team.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Manual CSV emailing is completely unscalable and lacks real-time observability.

questions.generalExplanation: CloudWatch Cross-Account Observability enables seamless, centralized monitoring and troubleshooting across accounts within an AWS Organization or across specific account IDs.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: An enterprise architecture team wants to track and measure architectural health across 50 production workloads over time, conducting periodic Well-Architected reviews, documenting high-risk issues (HRIs), and saving milestone snapshots as improvements are implemented. Which tool facilitates this governance?

options.text: AWS Snowmobile tracking portal.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Snowmobile is an exabyte data transport container truck.

options.text: Amazon Lex bot builder.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Amazon Lex builds conversational AI bots.

options.text: AWS Direct Connect management console.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Direct Connect manages dedicated physical network links.

options.text: AWS Well-Architected Tool with custom lenses and milestone tracking.
options.explanation: Correct: The AWS Well-Architected Tool provides a structured mechanism to review workloads against official pillars and custom organizational lenses, tracking high-risk issues (HRIs) and saving milestone snapshots over time.

questions.generalExplanation: The AWS Well-Architected Tool enables teams to review workloads, track architectural improvements over time with milestone snapshots, and share reviews across organizations.

questions.domainName: Domain 3: Continuous Improvement for Existing Solutions
questions.statement: An enterprise maintains replicated S3 buckets in us-east-1 and us-west-2. Global applications require a single S3 endpoint that automatically routes requests to the closest healthy bucket and allows administrators to shift 100% of read and write traffic to the secondary region in minutes during an operational event. Which feature provides this?

options.text: Amazon Route 53 Simple routing pointing to public S3 website endpoints.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Simple routing lacks automated failover controls and public website endpoints do not support authenticated REST APIs.

options.text: AWS Storage Gateway Volume mode.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Storage Gateway is a hybrid storage appliance.

options.text: Standard S3 bucket URLs with manual code changes in client applications.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Manual client code redeployments are slow and cannot meet rapid failover requirements.

options.text: Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points (MRAP) with Failover Controls
options.explanation: Correct: S3 MRAP provides a single global DNS endpoint backed by AWS Global Accelerator and includes active-passive or active-active Failover Controls to shift S3 read/write traffic between regions in minutes.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points with Failover Controls provide a single global S3 endpoint that dynamically routes traffic to the nearest bucket and allows instant traffic shifting between regions.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: An enterprise is migrating a legacy on-premises monolithic system to AWS. The environment consists of 15 physical Linux/Windows servers, a 12 TB active Oracle Database cluster with continuous transactions, and an 80 TB NAS share. The migration must achieve near-zero downtime (cutover within a 30-minute window). Which TWO AWS tools should be used for continuous data synchronization prior to cutover? (Choose TWO.)

options.text: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with Change Data Capture (CDC) to keep the Oracle database synchronized in real time with AWS until the cutover window.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS DMS with CDC captures ongoing transactions from the source database in real time, enabling near-instantaneous cutover.

options.text: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized to perform a one-time upload of Oracle database data on cutover day.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Physical shipping of Snowball takes days, making a 30-minute cutover window impossible.

options.text: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) to refactor the monolithic application code into AWS Lambda microservices.
options.explanation: Incorrect: DRS is for disaster recovery replication, not automatic microservices code refactoring.

options.text: AWS Application Migration Service (AWS MGN) to continuously replicate physical server disks at block level to AWS in the background.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS MGN installs lightweight agents to replicate physical and virtual servers at block level without downtime, enabling non-disruptive testing and rapid cutover.

options.text: AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) to convert virtual machines into AMIs every 24 hours.
options.explanation: Incorrect: AWS SMS is deprecated in favor of AWS MGN and does not support continuous block-level sync for physical servers.

questions.generalExplanation: For enterprise migrations with minimal downtime windows, AWS MGN handles continuous block-level server machine replication, while AWS DMS with CDC handles continuous real-time relational database transaction replication.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: An enterprise wants to modernize a commercial on-premises Microsoft SQL Server database to open-source Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL to eliminate expensive software licensing costs. The database contains complex stored procedures, PL/SQL scripts, and custom views. Which tool should be used to convert the database schema and stored procedures before migrating the data?

options.text: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)
options.explanation: Correct: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) automatically converts source database schemas, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views into the target database engine format (e.g., SQL Server to Aurora PostgreSQL).

options.text: AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager
options.explanation: Incorrect: Patch Manager updates operating system software on instances.

options.text: Amazon Athena
options.explanation: Incorrect: Athena is an interactive SQL analytics service on S3, not a database schema converter.

options.text: AWS CloudHSM
options.explanation: Incorrect: CloudHSM manages hardware encryption keys.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) is specifically designed to convert commercial database schemas, triggers, and stored procedures to open-source cloud-native engines like Amazon Aurora.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A company plans a large-scale migration of 500 on-premises VMware virtual machines to AWS. Before migrating, they need to gather automated inventory data, CPU/memory performance utilization metrics, and map network dependencies between servers to design migration waves. Which tool should be deployed in the VMware environment?

options.text: AWS Application Discovery Service using the agentless Discovery Connector (OVA) for VMware vCenter.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS Application Discovery Service Discovery Connector is an agentless appliance deployed in VMware vCenter that collects VM inventory, performance metrics, and network connection dependencies to plan migration waves.

options.text: Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics
options.explanation: Incorrect: Synthetics tests web endpoints, not on-premises VMware VM dependencies.

options.text: AWS CloudFormation StackSets
options.explanation: Incorrect: StackSets deploys infrastructure in AWS accounts, it does not inspect on-premises VMware clusters.

options.text: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway
options.explanation: Incorrect: Tape Gateway is a virtual tape backup appliance.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Application Discovery Service helps planning migrations by collecting server inventory, performance data, and network communication mappings from on-premises environments.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A media company needs to migrate 150 TB of shared file assets from an on-premises Network Attached Storage (NAS) appliance over a 1 Gbps Direct Connect link to Amazon EFS. The migration must preserve POSIX file permissions, timestamps, and ownership metadata, with automatic data verification. Which tool is optimized for this task?

options.text: AWS Snowmobile truck
options.explanation: Incorrect: Snowmobile is designed for exabytes of data and is cost-prohibitive for 150 TB.

options.text: AWS DataSync with a DataSync agent deployed on-premises.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS DataSync is a purpose-built online data transfer service that accelerates moving data between on-premises storage (NFS/SMB) and AWS (EFS, S3, FSx), preserving file metadata and performing end-to-end data integrity validation.

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB import tool
options.explanation: Incorrect: DynamoDB is a NoSQL database, not an NFS shared file system.

options.text: Standard rsync command running over public internet with no encryption.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Basic rsync over internet is slow, unaccelerated, unmanaged, and insecure.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS DataSync accelerates file data migrations up to 10x faster than open source tools by using a custom network protocol, preserving POSIX metadata, and automating integrity checks.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A research organization needs to migrate 600 TB of satellite imagery stored in an isolated data center facility with an unstable 10 Mbps internet connection into Amazon S3. What is the fastest and most cost-effective migration method?

options.text: Send hard drives via standard commercial postal mail to an AWS employee's home address.
options.explanation: Incorrect: This violates security protocols and AWS does not accept arbitrary personal mail-in drives.

options.text: Upload all files over the 10 Mbps internet link using AWS CLI multi-threading.
options.explanation: Incorrect: 600 TB over 10 Mbps takes over 15 years to transfer.

options.text: Deploy Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on the 10 Mbps link.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Transfer acceleration cannot overcome a fundamentally constrained 10 Mbps local bandwidth bottleneck.

options.text: Order multiple AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices, copy the data locally over high-speed LAN, and ship the encrypted devices back to AWS for upload to Amazon S3.
options.explanation: Correct: With a 10 Mbps connection, uploading 600 TB over the network would take over 15 years; ordering Snowball Edge devices achieves the migration within weeks.

questions.generalExplanation: When network bandwidth is severely limited, physical data transport appliances like AWS Snowball Edge provide the fastest and most economical method to migrate hundreds of terabytes of data.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A company wants to modernize legacy Java and .NET Framework web applications running on Windows and Linux virtual machines into Docker container images deployable to Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS without rewriting application code. Which AWS modernization tool automates this containerization process?

options.text: Amazon Lex
options.explanation: Incorrect: Amazon Lex builds conversational AI chatbots.

options.text: AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager
options.explanation: Incorrect: Patch Manager updates OS patches on servers.

options.text: AWS App2Container (A2C)
options.explanation: Correct: AWS App2Container is a command-line tool that analyzes and containerizes legacy Java and .NET web applications running on VMs into Docker images, generating ECS task definitions and Kubernetes deployment manifests automatically.

options.text: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway
options.explanation: Incorrect: Storage Gateway is a hybrid block/file storage bridge.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS App2Container (A2C) automates the containerization of legacy applications, creating container images, ECR repositories, and ECS/EKS deployment configurations.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: An on-premises radiology clinic produces 2 TB of medical scan files daily. On-premises medical applications require low-latency SMB/NFS file share access to recently generated files, but older files must be automatically stored cost-effectively in Amazon S3 for long-term retention. Which hybrid storage solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Deploy an Amazon S3 File Gateway (AWS Storage Gateway) on-premises in VMware ESXi.
options.explanation: Correct: Amazon S3 File Gateway presents an industry-standard NFS/SMB file share on-premises with local caching for low-latency access, while asynchronously writing files directly as native objects to Amazon S3.

options.text: Deploy Amazon FSx for Lustre on an on-premises physical server.
options.explanation: Incorrect: FSx for Lustre is an AWS cloud managed service, not an on-premises downloadable VM appliance.

options.text: Mount an Amazon S3 bucket directly over public internet using third-party FUSE drivers on every client PC.
options.explanation: Incorrect: FUSE mounts over WAN lack local hardware caching performance and create high latency.

options.text: Store all scans on USB flash drives stored in office filing cabinets.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Physical flash drives lack durability, compliance, and cloud integration.

questions.generalExplanation: Amazon S3 File Gateway bridges on-premises environments and cloud storage, providing local low-latency caching via SMB/NFS while storing data as native objects in Amazon S3.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: An insurance enterprise wants to migrate and modernize legacy COBOL-based IBM z/OS mainframe core workloads to AWS cloud native microservices with automated refactoring. Which managed service provides the tooling and runtime environment for this migration?

options.text: Amazon Lex
options.explanation: Incorrect: Lex is a conversational chatbot service.

options.text: AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized
options.explanation: Incorrect: Snowball Edge provides edge compute and storage for physical data transport, not mainframe COBOL code refactoring.

options.text: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway
options.explanation: Incorrect: Tape Gateway is a virtual tape backup appliance.

options.text: AWS Mainframe Modernization service (using AWS Blu Age automated refactoring)
options.explanation: Correct: AWS Mainframe Modernization service with AWS Blu Age automatically analyzes, converts, and refactors legacy COBOL/PL1 mainframe applications into modern Java-based cloud microservices.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Mainframe Modernization provides managed tools and runtimes (including AWS Blu Age and Micro Focus) to migrate and modernize mainframe workloads to AWS.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A multinational enterprise is managing hundreds of application migrations across multiple AWS accounts using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), and partner tools. They need a single centralized dashboard to track migration progress across all applications and servers. Which service should they use?

options.text: Amazon Polly
options.explanation: Incorrect: Polly converts text into speech.

options.text: Amazon Route 53 Traffic Flow
options.explanation: Incorrect: Route 53 Traffic Flow manages DNS routing policies.

options.text: AWS Cloud9
options.explanation: Incorrect: Cloud9 is a cloud IDE for code authoring.

options.text: AWS Migration Hub
options.explanation: Correct: AWS Migration Hub provides a single central location to track the progress of application migrations across multiple AWS and partner tools (MGN, DMS, ATADATA, CloudEndure).

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Migration Hub gives you a single place to track the progress of application migrations across your entire portfolio, regardless of which migration tools you use.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: An e-commerce company is migrating an on-premises 8 TB PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The database is actively processing orders 24/7. How can the database be migrated with zero data loss and less than 5 minutes of total cutover downtime?

options.text: Run an AWS Lambda function that executes SELECT * and INSERT statements every 10 seconds.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Custom Lambda querying lacks transaction consistency, duplicates records, and drops data.

options.text: Shut down the on-premises database, run pg_dump to a USB drive, and drive it to an AWS data center.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Physical transport causes hours or days of business downtime.

options.text: Take daily manual snapshots in on-premises PostgreSQL and copy them to S3 Glacier.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Snapshots cannot be restored into Aurora PostgreSQL with live continuous CDC syncing.

options.text: Deploy an AWS DMS replication instance, perform Full Load of existing data, enable Ongoing Replication (Change Data Capture - CDC), wait for replication lag to reach zero, and switch application connection strings during the 5-minute cutover window.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS DMS with Full Load + CDC synchronizes initial data while continuously capturing live transactional changes, allowing the cutover to occur in minutes with zero data loss.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS DMS Full Load combined with Ongoing Replication (Change Data Capture / CDC) enables database migrations with near-zero downtime by continuously replicating transaction logs.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A company is migrating 200 Windows and Linux servers to AWS using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN). As part of migration modernization, every launched instance must automatically install the AWS Systems Manager (SSM) agent, configure CloudWatch monitoring, and install disaster recovery software upon first boot. How should this be automated?

options.text: Configure an S3 Glacier Vault Lock policy on the source servers.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Vault Lock enforces S3 archival compliance, not EC2 post-boot software installation.

options.text: Configure AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) Post-Launch Actions using built-in and custom AWS Systems Manager automation documents.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS MGN Post-Launch Actions allow you to automatically execute actions (such as installing SSM agent, CloudWatch agent, or running custom SSM documents) on target instances immediately upon launch.

options.text: Deploy Amazon CloudFront in front of the server boot sectors.
options.explanation: Incorrect: CloudFront is a web CDN and does not interact with OS boot sectors.

options.text: Log into all 200 servers manually via RDP/SSH after cutover.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Manual server-by-server configuration is slow, error-prone, and unscalable.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS MGN Post-Launch Settings allow you to automate post-launch tasks, configuration updates, and agent installations using AWS Systems Manager upon server migration.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: During a portfolio assessment of 100 enterprise applications, the architecture team identifies an obsolete on-premises commercial CRM software suite that will be retired and replaced with a modern cloud Software as a Service (SaaS) provider (Salesforce). According to AWS migration 7 Rs framework, which migration strategy is this?

options.text: Refactor / Re-architect
options.explanation: Incorrect: Refactoring involves rewriting application code to cloud-native serverless or microservices architectures.

options.text: Replatform (Lift, Tinker, and Shift)
options.explanation: Incorrect: Replatforming modifies basic components (like moving database to managed RDS) while keeping core app code.

options.text: Rehost (Lift and Shift)
options.explanation: Incorrect: Rehosting lifts and shifts existing VMs directly to EC2 without changing software.

options.text: Repurchase (Drop and Shop)
options.explanation: Correct: Repurchasing (also known as 'drop and shop') refers to replacing existing on-premises software with a modern SaaS solution or upgraded cloud-native licensing model.

questions.generalExplanation: The 'Repurchase' strategy in the AWS 7 Rs migration framework involves moving to a different product, typically a SaaS platform (e.g., transitioning from an on-premises CRM to a cloud SaaS CRM).

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A supply chain enterprise receives invoices from 500 external B2B partners via SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol). The enterprise wants to eliminate on-premises SFTP servers and store incoming files directly in Amazon S3 without requiring external partners to change their client SFTP configurations, hostnames, or authentication keys. Which service should they implement?

options.text: AWS CodeDeploy with Auto Scaling groups.
options.explanation: Incorrect: CodeDeploy is a deployment automation service.

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB with public HTTP REST endpoints.
options.explanation: Incorrect: External B2B partners use SFTP clients, not custom DynamoDB HTTP APIs.

options.text: Deploy an EC2 instance running open-source vsftpd with an EBS volume.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Self-hosted EC2 FTP servers require patching, scaling, high availability management, and lack native serverless S3 integration.

options.text: AWS Transfer Family for SFTP with custom domain names and Amazon S3 as the storage backend.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS Transfer Family provides fully managed SFTP, FTPS, and FTP endpoints backed directly by Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS, supporting custom hostnames, SSH keys, and custom identity providers without altering partner workflows.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Transfer Family allows you to seamlessly migrate file transfer workflows to AWS by integrating with Amazon S3 and EFS while maintaining existing SFTP client configurations.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A bank maintains physical tape libraries and tape drives with backup software (Veeam / Commvault) to backup on-premises data to physical magnetic tapes. They want to eliminate physical tape hardware, offsite tape shipment, and physical vault storage costs without modifying their existing backup software workflows. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.text: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway (Virtual Tape Library - VTL) on-premises, writing virtual tapes to Amazon S3 and archiving to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.explanation: Correct: Tape Gateway emulates a physical Virtual Tape Library (VTL) compatible with major backup software (Veeam, Commvault, Veritas), storing virtual tapes seamlessly in S3 and S3 Glacier Flexible/Deep Archive.

options.text: Deploy Amazon CloudSearch across all on-premises servers.
options.explanation: Incorrect: CloudSearch is a search engine, not a tape backup bridge.

options.text: Use AWS Direct Connect public VIFs with open SSH ports.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Direct Connect does not emulate a Virtual Tape Library.

options.text: Export data daily to USB thumb drives and mail them to AWS data centers.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Manual mailing of USB drives violates banking security standards and lacks automation.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway replaces physical tapes on-premises with virtual tapes in AWS, reducing physical tape management overhead while preserving existing backup software investments.

questions.domainName: Domain 4: Accelerate Workload Migration and Modernization
questions.statement: A government agency has custom-hardened on-premises Windows and Red Hat Enterprise Linux golden VM images (VMDK and VHD formats) that have undergone strict security certifications. How can the agency import these pre-configured virtual machine disk images directly into AWS to launch them as Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)?

options.text: Attach an SCP denying ec2:RunInstances in all accounts.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Denying run instances prevents launching compute instances entirely.

options.text: Copy the VMDK files into Amazon DynamoDB and run a partition query.
options.explanation: Incorrect: DynamoDB is a NoSQL database; it cannot store or convert raw VM disk image files.

options.text: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway in cached mode.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Tape Gateway is for virtual tape backup software, not VM AMI conversions.

options.text: Upload the VMDK/VHD image files to an Amazon S3 bucket and use the VM Import/Export service (aws ec2 import-image) to convert them into EC2 AMIs.
options.explanation: Correct: AWS VM Import/Export enables you to import VM disk images (VMDK, VHD, OVA) from S3 directly into Amazon EC2 as custom AMIs, preserving existing OS customizations and hardening configurations.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS VM Import/Export allows organizations to easily import virtual machine images from existing virtualization environments into Amazon EC2 to create ready-to-launch AMIs.
